description: The gentle curve of the Arched Top Convertible Crib adds soft elegance that feels right at home in any nursery. Expertly crafted from solid hardwoods by Pennsylvania artisans, this 4-in-1 piece converts from crib to toddler bed, daybed, and full-size bed with ease. Safe, versatile, and finished to match your style, it’s the crib parents fall in love with the first time they see it—and keep loving long after the baby years.
